spots.name: Liefdesbankje
tags: artist: Guusje Beverdam, Struktuur68, Luigi Zuliani Kunst & Terazzo
spots.blurb: You've reached Liefdesbankje, a street art piece by Guusje Beverdam, Struktuur68, Luigi Zuliani Kunst & Terazzo. Ceramic couch. Destroyed in 2020 due to collision with truck, reconstructed and placed back in 2022. Original author is Guusje Beverdam, but the reconstruction process was done by Struktuur68 from Den Haag and Luigi Zuliani Kunst & Terazzo from Zoetermeer.
